criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Luware Nimbus qualifies as a core CCaaS peer in CLS-CC-004. It is packaged SaaS with Microsoft Teams Phone as a structural communications dependency; Extend/Unify variation belongs in fit and implementation, not a new class.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Best fit is Microsoft-centric midmarket-to-enterprise service/contact-center operations. Unify materially expands beyond a Teams-UI-only model through NimbusOne and CRM CTI while keeping Teams Phone as the communications foundation.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Nimbus offers regional Azure clusters in Switzerland, Germany, Western Europe, UK, US and Australia, but workload sovereignty is path-specific. AI and messaging providers can introduce other processing regions.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Telephony is Microsoft Teams Phone-centric with Direct Routing, Calling Plan and Operator Connect support. Buyers inherit Microsoft Teams Phone licensing, PSTN and service dependencies rather than a Luware-owned carrier abstraction.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Strong when Teams Phone is strategic; declines when carrier/control-plane independence is mandatory.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Routing is substantive: workflow queues, availability/skill/priority routing, callbacks, service distribution, external tasks and Contact Center policies are documented. Microsoft presence and Nimbus duty/task states influence routing.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Digital scope includes Interact web experiences, email, external tasks, SMS and WhatsApp. Channels have separate provider, licensing, concurrency and policy dependencies, so omnichannel support is not one uniform runtime.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Outbound supports service calls, scheduled outbound tasks and callbacks. Public evidence does not establish specialist predictive/progressive dialer depth; scheduled task limits and Teams/PSTN dependencies are explicit.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Nimbus includes supervision and reporting, but full WFM is external through OData/data aggregation and compliance/QM can involve separate Luware Recording or partners. One native WEM control plane is not established.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Live/historical reporting, dashboards, OData and Power BI are substantive. Dashboard/query limits exist and longer-horizon analytics/WFM may rely on external tools.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Extend keeps users in Teams; Unify adds NimbusOne, Salesforce CTI, Dynamics CTI and client-of-choice experiences. Workspace choice is materially broader than the Phase 1 Teams-only shorthand.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Developer model includes REST provisioning API, OData, Power Automate triggers/actions, authenticated web requests and workflow integrations. It is strong for Microsoft-aligned automation but carries Azure/Power Platform ownership.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Reporting/configuration data is retained in Nimbus and exposed through OData/Power BI; retention is configurable. AI data has separate retention/export paths. Exit requires explicit mapping for data, workflows, numbers and connected systems.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Luware documents geographically distributed Azure datacenters, geo-redundant backup/failover, cluster rollout and a status service. Guaranteed SLAs exist, but full public numeric SLA/remedy/RTO/RPO detail was not validated.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Security posture includes SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and Microsoft app/contact-center certification. Regulated buyers still need product/region-specific contractual scope, support access and subprocessor validation.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: AI Assist is substantive through Companion transcription, live captioning, summarization, codes/tags and knowledge assistance; availability and licensing vary by service and feature.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Generative AI outputs include summaries, knowledge responses and virtual-agent conversational output. Outputs depend on configured AI services and require buyer truth-set evaluation.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Nimbus automates workflow branching, classification, task creation and external-system calls through Power Automate, Web Requests and Virtual User outcomes.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Virtual Users can use MCP/Web Requests for tool actions, but permissions, idempotency, rollback and transaction verification are not established as universal built-in guarantees.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Nimbus orchestrates human and AI routing through workflows, outcomes and handoff. The September 2026 release adds structured Virtual User-to-human context handoff, but rollout is cluster-sequenced and not every handoff case is equivalent.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Model dependency is mixed: Nimbus-managed and customer-configured AI services, Azure OpenAI GPT Realtime and Copilot Studio are supported in different profiles. Choice exists, with external model/service and regional dependencies.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Grounding options include official Nimbus documentation through Companion plus external tools/knowledge via MCP/Web Requests and Copilot. Buyer-specific knowledge governance, freshness and citation behavior require proof.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: AI governance includes tenant consent, feature toggles, storage controls and bot/profile configuration, but consequential action governance remains distributed across Nimbus, Microsoft/model services and external tools.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: AI implementation can require speech recognizers, Azure AI endpoints, bot configuration, MCP/Web Requests, consent, workflow mapping and regression testing. Preview/cluster rollout states make production operability feature-specific.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Critical-system integrations include Salesforce/Dynamics patterns, Power Automate, authenticated web requests and CRM context. Microsoft 365/Teams is a structural dependency rather than merely another connector.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Integration depth ranges from native Microsoft Graph/TPE/ACS to Power Automate, REST API, OData, web requests and embedded/CRM clients; depth is real but heterogeneous.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Integration failure can degrade routing context, task creation, CRM actions, AI tools or reporting while core calls may continue depending on path. End-to-end observability is shared across Nimbus, Microsoft and third parties.

criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.
